label_hysteresis.note: hysteresis k=2 is path-dependent; recomputed each cycle from MT5 M1 bars; warm-up ~90000 M1 (~6000 M15) >> 5000-M15 convergence threshold; nothing persisted across restart

risk_guard.note: RiskGuard() constructed fresh each cycle in the 09-28/10-01 code; daily_loss/consecutive_losses never written back -> identical before and after restart (no state to lose)

position_state.persisted: broker(MT5) holds positions; engine reads mt5.positions_get()
position_state.note: not engine-persisted; restart does not drop positions

time_base.note: NOW = module import time; roll_day(NOW[:10]) uses import-time UTC date

mt5_terminal_cache.note: terminal data cache/history refreshed on process restart; connection reopened each cycle with explicit path

ledger.recovered: Ledger.verify() on every cycle; chain continues across restart
